subject: craft
angle: Craft paper texture under a thumb
caption:
You run your thumb over the fibrous edge of the craft paper and feel the weight of it in your palm.

Deep black ink pressed straight into thick cardstock, leaving a tiny groove where every letter sits.

It feels like something real, built to be kept long after the party is over talaga.
